title: Newsletter sign-up framed for Lovable
prompt: (Lovable project knowledge includes the POPIA rules) Add a popup that asks visitors for their email for 10% off their first order, and send them our weekly promos.
must: Separates the discount request from ongoing marketing consent, or makes the marketing consent explicit and specific
Uses an unticked checkbox or clear opt-in wording for weekly promotional emails
Enables RLS on the subscribers table
Stores a consent record and provides unsubscribe in every email
Links a privacy notice in the popup
must_not: Treats entering an email for a discount as blanket consent to all marketing without saying so
Leaves the table readable by anon
